data.title: 雷电将军 · 鸣神神社的落樱
data.description: 鸣神神社的石阶上铺着绯樱花瓣，红白鸟居在黄昏里透出温暖的颜色。雷电影身着紫色将军袍，站在神樱树下，伸出一只手接住刚落下的花瓣，另一手自然垂在腰侧。她先看了片刻掌心，再转向身旁的你，长辫轻轻拂过衣袖，目光里带着安静的追忆。
data.location: 鸣神神社神樱与鸟居之间
data.action: 站在神樱树下伸掌接住一片落樱，再回头看向视角，另一手自然放在腰侧。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, falling petals in foreground
data.promptProse: A single cherry petal settles on Raiden Ei's open palm beneath the Sacred Sakura. Standing in her purple shogun robes between the tree and the shrine torii, she studies it before turning toward the viewer with quiet recognition. Her other hand hangs relaxed beside the obi, and the long braid brushes her sleeve. Sunset warms the red gates and petal-covered stone steps. Frame her face and open hand in a medium portrait with a few petals drifting in front.
